# 7 Paradigmas
## Proyecto Lenguajes de Programacion
This is Benny Marcano's Computer Language class' MidTerm project.
\n
It includes 7 programs that vary in the programming languages they were created on, on 7 different logistical paradigms.
\n
Imperative: Prime finder written in Python (Pyscript) \n
Functional: Calculator written in Elm \n
Logical: Family reasoner written in Prolog \n
OOP: blackjack written in C++ \n
Extra: Music hub written in JavaScript \n
Extra 2: Game review program written in JavaScript \n
CV: written with JavaScript \n
\n
*Most of the code used was generated by Claude.AI, with modifications done by me.
